suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as disease complication. Require established ankylosing spondylitis and independently documented osteoporosis/low bone density consistent with the source phenotype. Osteoporosis is a recognized complication, but individual bone loss is multifactorial; do not assume every AS patient develops osteoporosis. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Ankylosing Spondylitis and Osteoporosis, Residuals of
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
